component.name: PCOC Hike
component.summary: Produce, verify and sign in with Satoshi Hike v2.0 objects

description.p: PCOC Hike records a Satoshi Hike v2.0 object against the Bitcoin header chain, shows the section 14 record for any object, and submits one groundinglab sign-in. It links the pinned Rust reference in-process.
An nsec is pasted or generated for the session. It stays in memory and is never written. The npub is derived from it.
Produce, verify, and sign in. The nsec stays in memory.
